text: 在2026云栖大会上，千问办公宣布将接入阿里云上的Salesforce（Salesforce on Alibaba Cloud）。此次接入，将结合千问办公的企业上下文理解、任务规划执行能力与Salesforce的客户管理能力，让企业员工能够在千问办公中查询销售商机、维护客户信息、推进业务流程，在日常办公中更便捷地处理客户管理与销售相关工作。（上证报）
text_en: At the 2026 Yunqi Conference, Qianwen Office announced that it will integrate with Salesforce on Alibaba Cloud. This integration will combine Qianwen Office's enterprise context understanding and task planning and execution capabilities with Salesforce's customer management capabilities, enabling enterprise employees to query sales opportunities, maintain customer information, and advance business processes within Qianwen Office, making it more convenient to handle customer management and sales-related work in daily office operations. (Shanghai Securities News)
